verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ ሰምዐ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ሕዝቅያስ፡ ሠጠጠ፡ አልባሲሁ፡ ወለብበ፡ ሠቀ፡ ወቦአ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: And it came to pass when king Ezekias heard it, that he rent his clothes, and put on sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.

verses.geez:
ወለአኮሙ፡ ለኤልያቄም፡ መጋቢ፡ ወለስምናስ፡ ጸሓፊ፡ ወለሊቃነ፡ ካህናት፡ እንዘ፡ ልቡስ፡ ሠቀ፡ ኀበ፡ ኢሳይያስ፡
            ነቢይ፡ ወልደ፡ አሞጽ።
verses.translation: And he sent Heliakim the steward, and Somnas the scribe, and the elders of the priests, clothed with sackcloth, to Esaias the prophet the son of Amos.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ዕለተ፡ ምንዳቤ፡ ዮምአ፡ ወዕለተ፡ መንሱትአ፡ ወመቅሠፍትአ፡ ዛቲ፡ ዕለት፡ እስመ፡ አኀዛ፡ ማሕምም፡ ለእንተ፡ ትወልድ፡ ወኀይለ፡ አልባቲ።
verses.translation: And they said to him, Thus says Ezekias, This day is a day of tribulation, and rebuke, and provocation: for the children are come to the travail-pangs, but the mother has no strength.

verses.geez:
እመ፡ ከመ፡ ቦአ፡ ከመአ፡ ይስማዕ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላክ፡ ንባቦ፡ ለረፋስቂስ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘነበበ፡ ዘለአከ፡ ንጉሠ፡
            ፋርስ፡ እግዚኡ፡ ከመ፡ ይፀርፍ፡ ላዕለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ሕያውአ፡ ወያስተሐቅሮአ፡ በነገር፡ ዘሰምዐ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላክከ፡ ወጸሊ፡ ላዕሌነአ፡ ለእለአ፡ ተረፍነአ።
verses.translation: Peradventure the Lord thy God will hear all the words of Rapsakes, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to reproach the living God and to revile him with the words which the Lord thy God has heard: and thou shalt offer thy prayer for the remnant that is found.

verses.geez: ወበጽሑ፡ ደቀ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ኀበ፡ ኢሳይያስ።
verses.translation: So the servants of king Ezekias came to Esaias.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎሙ፡ ኢሳይያስ፡ በልዎ፡ ለእግዚእክሙ፡ ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኢትፍራህአ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ ለዝአ፡ ነገርአ፡ ዘሰማዕከ፡ ዘፀረፋ፡ ደቁ፡ ለንጉሠ፡ ፋርስአ።
verses.translation: And Esaias said to them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the Lord, Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of the Assyrians have blasphemed.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ አነ፡ እፌኑ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወይሰምዑ፡ ዜና፡ ወይገብኡ፡ ብሔሮሙአ፡ ወእቀትሎሙ፡ በብሔሮሙአ፡ በኲናትአ።
verses.translation: Behold, I send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a report, and shall return to his own land; and I will overthrow him with the sword in his own land.

verses.geez: ወገብአ፡ ረፋስቂስ፡ ወረከቦ፡ ለንጉሥ፡ ይትቃተል፡ ምስለ፡ ሎምና፡ እስመ፡ ሰምዐ፡ ከመ፡ አፅረሩ፡ እምነ፡ ለኪስ።
verses.translation: So Rapsakes returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Lobna: for he heard that he had departed from Lachis.

verses.geez:
ወሰምዐ፡ በእንተ፡ ታራ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ኢትዮጵያ፡ ወይቤልዎ፡ ናሁ፡ ወፅአ፡ ይትቃተል፡ ምስሌከ፡ ወተመይጠ፡ ወለአከ፡
            ሐዋርያተ፡ ኀበ፡ ሕዝቅያስ፡ እንዘ፡ ይብል ፤
verses.translation: And he heard concerning Tharaca king of the Ethiopians, saying, Behold, he is come forth to fight with thee: and he returned, and sent messengers to Ezekias, saying,

verses.geez: ኢያስሕትከ፡ አምላክከ፡ ዘቦቱአ፡ ተአመንከ፡ እስመ፡ ይቤለከ፡ ኢትገብእ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ ውስተ፡ እደ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ፋርስ።
verses.translation: Let not thy God on whom thou trustest encourage thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hands of the king of the Assyrians.

verses.geez: ለሊከአ፡ ሰማዕከ፡ ኵሎአ፡ ዘገብሩ፡ ነገሥተ፡ ፋርስ፡ ወኵሎ፡ በሓውርተ፡ ዘከመ፡ ይምሰስዎ።
verses.translation: Behold, thou hast heard all that the kings of the Assyrians have done in all the lands, to waste them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?

verses.geez:
ቦኑአ፡ እምውስተ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ እለ፡ ቀተልናሆሙ፡ ቦኑ፡ ዘአድኀኖሙ፡ ወእለኒ፡ ቀተሉ፡ አበውየ፡ ጎዘን፡
            ወካራን፡ ወራፌስ፡ ወልደ፡ ሴዴቄን፡ እለ፡ ውስተ፡ ታኤሴቴም።
verses.translation: Have the gods of the nations at all delivered them, whom my fathers destroyed; both Gozan, and Charran, and Raphis, and the sons of Edem who were in Thaesthen?

verses.geez: አይቴአ፡ ውእቱአ፡ ንጉሠ፡ አርፋት፡ ወንጉሠ፡ ኤማት ፤ ኦይቴአ፡ ሌፋሩ፡ ወኤናን፡ ወአጉገዌ።
verses.translation: Where is the king of Hæmath, and the king of Arphad? and where is the king of the city of Seppharvaim, of Ana, and Aba?

verses.geez:
ወነሥአ፡ ሕዝቅያስ፡ እምእዴሆሙ፡ ለሐዋርያት፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ወአንበባ፡ ወዐርገ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወከሠታ፡
            ሕዝቅያስ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: And Ezekias took the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and he went up to the house of the Lord, and Ezekias spread it before the Lord,

verses.geez:
ወይቤ፡ እግዚኦ፡ አምላከ፡ እስራኤል፡ ዘትነብር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኪሩቤል፡ አንተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ባሕቲትከ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡
            መንግሥታተ፡ ዓለም፡ ወአንተ፡ ገበርከ፡ ሰማየ፡ ወምድረ።
verses.translation: and said, O Lord God of Israel, that dwellest over the cherubs, thou art the only God in all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth.

verses.geez: አፅምእ፡ እዝነከ፡ ወስምዐኒ፡ ወክሥት፡ አዕይንቲከ፡ ወርኢ፡ ወስማዕ፡ ቃሎ፡ ለሰናክሬም፡ ዘለአከ፡ እንዘ፡ ያስተሐቅሮ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ሕያው።
verses.translation: Incline thine ear, O Lord, and hear: open, Lord, thine eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherim, which he has sent to reproach the living God.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አማን፡ እግዚኦ፡ አጥፍእዎሙ፡ ነገሥተ፡ ፋርስ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፤
verses.translation: For truly, Lord, the kings of Assyria have wasted the nations,

verses.geez:
ወአውዐይዎሙ፡ ለአማልክቲሆሙ፡ በእሳት፡ እስመ፡ ኢኮኑ፡ አማልክተ፡ እስመ፡ ግብረ፡ እደ፡ ሰብእ፡ እሙንቱ ፤ ዕፀው፡
            ወእብን፡ እሙንቱ ፤ ወአጥፍእዎሙ።
verses.translation: and have cast their gods into the fire: because they are no gods, but the works of men's hands, wood and stone; and they have destroyed them.

verses.geez:
ወይእዜኒ፡ እግዚኦ፡ አምላክነ፡ አድኅነነ፡ እምእዴሁ፡ ወያእምሩ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ነገሥተ፡ ምድር፡ ከመ፡ አንተ፡ ውእቱ፡
            እግዚአብሔር፡ ባሕቲትከ።
verses.translation: And now, O Lord our God, deliver us out of his hand, and all the kingdoms of the earth shall know that thou alone art the Lord God.

verses.geez:
ወለአከ፡ ኢሳይያስ፡ ወልደ፡ አሞጽ፡ ኀበ፡ ሕዝቅያስ፡ እንዘ፡ ይብል፡ ከመዝአ፡ ይቤአ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላከ፡
            ኀይልአ፡ አምላከ፡ እስራኤል፡ ሰማዕኩ፡ ዘጸለይከ፡ ኀቤየ፡ በእንተ፡ ሰናክሬምአ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ፋርስአ።
verses.translation: And Esaias the son of Amos sent to Ezekias, saying, Thus saith the Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel, I have heard thy prayer to me concerning Sennacherim king of the Assyrians.

verses.geez:
ወዝውእቱአ፡ ቃልአ፡ ዘነበበ፡ እግዚአብሔርአ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ጸዐለኪአ፡ ወአስተሐቅረኪአ፡ ወለተ፡ ጽዮንአ፡ ወአሖሰ፡ ርእሶ፡
            ላዕሌኪ፡ ወለተ፡ ኢየሩሳሌምአ።
verses.translation: This is the word which the Lord has spoken against him; The virgin daughter of Sion has made light of thee, and mocked thee; the daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at thee.

verses.geez:
መነ፡ ጸዐልከ፡ ወላዕለ፡ መኑ፡ አዕበይከ፡ አፉከአ ፤ ነጽር፡ ሰማያተ፡ በአዕይንቲከ፡ ኀበ፡ ቅዱስ፡ እስራኤል፡
            ዘበእዴሆሙ፡ ለመላእክቲሁ።
verses.translation: Whom hast thou reproached, and whom hast thou reviled? and against whom hast thou lifted up thy voice, and raised thine eyes on high? Is it against the Holy One of Israel?

verses.geez: ወአንተሰ፡ ጸዐልከ፡ እግዚእከ፡ ወትቤ፡ በብዝኀ፡ ሰረገላትየ፡ አዐርግ፡ ሰማያተ፡ ወውስተ፡ አድባር፡ ነዋኃት፡ አድባረ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ ወገዘምኩ፡ ዐበይተ፡ ቄድሮስ፡ ወሠናየ፡ ቄጶረስስ፡ ወበጻሕኩ፡ ማእከለ፡ ገዳም።
verses.translation: By thy messengers thou hast reproached the Lord, and hast said, I will go up with the multitude of my chariots, to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Libanus, and I have cut down the height of his cedar, and his choice cypresses; and I have come into the midst of the forest and of Carmel.

verses.geez: ወአዕረፍኩ፡ አንሰ፡ ወሰተይኩ፡ ማየ፡ ነኪር፡ ወአይበስኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዐውደ፡ ወአፍላገ፡ በመከየደ፡ እገርየ።
verses.translation: I have refreshed myself, and have drunk strange waters, and I have dried up with the sole of my foot all the rivers of fortified places.

verses.geez: ወገበርክዎሂ፡ ወአምጻእክዎሂ፡ ወከንቶ፡ ለአንሥኦ፡ እምኀበ፡ ኤቄሴዮም፡ ዘማኪሞን፡ አህጉር፡ ጽኑዓት።
verses.translation: I have brought about the matter, I have brought it to a conclusion; and it is come to the destruction of the bands of warlike prisoners, even of strong cities.

verses.geez:
ወእለኒ፡ ይነብሩ፡ ውስቴቶን፡ ደክማ፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ ወተመውኡ፡ ወተኀፈሩ፡ ወከኑ፡ ከመ፡ ሣዕረ፡ ገዳም፡ ወከመ፡
            ሐመልማለ፡ ሐምል፡ ወከመ፡ ሣዕረ፡ አንሕስት፡ ወሴዴማ፡ ቅድመ፡ ዘይቀውም፡ መንበርከ።
verses.translation: And they that dwelt in them were weak in hand, they quaked and were confounded, they became as grass of the field, or as the green herb, the grass growing on houses, and that which is trodden down by him that stands upon it.

verses.geez: ወበአትከኒ፡ ወፀአትከኒ፡ ወአእመርኩ፡ መዐትከኒ፡ ዘተመዓዕከ፡ ላዕሌየ።
verses.translation: But I know thy down-sitting, and thy going forth, and thy rage against me.

verses.geez: ወፍሒሎትከኒ፡ ዐርገ፡ ውስተ፡ እዘንየ፡ ወእወዲ፡ መሣግርየ፡ ውስተ፡ አንፍከ፡ ወልጓመ፡ ማእከለ፡ ከናፍሪከ፡ ወእመይጠከ፡ ፍኖተ፡ እንተ፡ ባቲ፡ መጻእከ።
verses.translation: Because thou wast angry against me, and thy fierceness is come up into my ears, therefore will I put my hooks in thy nostrils, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

verses.geez:
ወዝአ፡ ተኣምሪሁአ ፤ ብላዕአ፡ ዘዓመተ፡ እክልሰ፡ ዘለሊሁ፡ ይበቍል፡ ወካልአኒ፡ ዓመተ፡ ዘበቈለ፡ ወአመ፡ ፫ዓመት፡
            ዝራእ፡ ወእረር፡ ወትክል፡ ወይነ፡ ወብላዕ፡ ፍሬሁ።
verses.translation: And this shall be a sign to thee; eat this year the things that grow of themselves, and in the second year the things which spring up: and in the third year let there be sowing, and reaping, and planting of vineyards, and eat ye the fruit of them.

verses.geez: ወይበዝኅአ፡ ቤተአ፡ ይሁዳአ፡ ዘተረፈ፡ ሥርዉ፡ በታሕቱ፡ ወይገብር፡ ፍሬሁ፡ በላዕሌሁ።
verses.translation: And he shall increase him that has escaped of the house of Juda: and the remnant shall strike root beneath, and it shall produce fruit above.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እምኢየሩሳሌም፡ ይወዕእ፡ ተረፎሙ፡ ዘድኅነ፡ እምደብረ፡ ጽዮን ፤ ቅንኡ፡ ለእግዚአብሔርአ፡ ይገብሮአ፡ ለዝንቱአ።
verses.translation: For from Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and he that escapes from the mountain of Sion: the zeal of the Lord of hosts shall do this.

verses.geez:
ወአኮ፡ ከማሁአ ፤ ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በእንተ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ፋርስ፡ ኢይበውእ፡ ውስተዝ፡ ሀገር፡ ይቤ፡
            እግዚአብሔር፡ ኢይነድፍ፡ በህየ፡ ሐጸ፡ ወኢይቀርብ፡ ንዋየ፡ ሐቅሉ፡ ወኢይከይድ፡ ምድረ።
verses.translation: Is it not so? Thus saith the Lord concerning the king of the Assyrians, He shall not enter into this city, and he shall not shoot an arrow there, neither shall a shield come against it, neither shall he heap a mound against it.

verses.geez: በፍኖት፡ እንተ፡ መጽአ፡ ይገብእ፡ ወኢይበውእ፡ ውስተ፡ ዛቲ፡ ሀገር፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: By the way by which he comes, by it shall he return, and he shall not enter into this city, saith the Lord.

verses.geez: ወአጸንዓ፡ ለዛቲ፡ ሀገር፡ በእንተ፡ ዳዊት፡ ገብርየ።
verses.translation: And I will defend this city as with a shield, for my own sake, and for my servant David's sake.

verses.geez:
ወእምዝ፡ ወፅአ፡ መልአከ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወቀተለ፡ እምውስተ፡ ተዓይኒሆሙ፡ ለፋርስ፡ ፲ወ፰፼ወ፶፻፡ ወሶበ፡ ነቅሁ፡
            በጽባሕ፡ ረከቡ፡ አብድንተ፡ ኵሎሙ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass at night that the angel of the Lord went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and eighty-five thousand: and they rose early in the morning, and, behold, these were all dead corpses.

verses.geez: ወተንሥኡ፡ ወገዐዙ፡ ወሖሩ፡ ወአተወ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ፋርስ፡ ወነበረ፡ ውስተ፡ ነነዌ።
verses.translation: And Sennacherim king of the Assyrians departed, and went and returned, and dwelt in Nineve.

verses.geez:
ወእንዘ፡ ይሰግድ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ አምላኩ፡ ሲድራክ፡ አድራሜሌክ፡ ወሰሮሰር፡ ደቂቁ፡ ቀተልዎ፡ በኀጺን፡ ወአምሠጡ፡
            እሙንቱ፡ ብሔረ፡ አሮራት፡ ወነግሠ፡ ሆናሕርጻን፡ ወልዱ፡ ህየንቴሁ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass, while he was worshipping in the house of Meserach his god, that Adramelech and Sarasar his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Ararath; and Asordan his son reigned in his stead.
